description: An item's value recipe a supplies its value and implied image, ahead of the constituent's verbatim image recipe. Ordinary Sound tags do not supply strings (engine §11.2).
grammar:
%rule text ε | (text piece)
%rule piece word | _White_Space
%rule word :- $.verbatim-text | "a" | (word "a") %emits $ :: (W ∪ Sound-0061-s) := "a"
